verdict.rationale: Kommo documents its own event-driven automation: a constructor sets up automatic system reactions to events such as lead stage changes and website visits, and SalesBot runs automated conversation scenarios. These run without user intervention, which delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of recurring time-based schedules (as opposed to event triggers), in-depth docs on background execution behavior and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
